what: The plugin compiles in the vxl project: all four modules, with UHT on the USTRUCTs (FUniCoord, FUniCellKey, FUniObjectId) and the UFUNCTION library.
UE Automation tests (UnifiedUniverse.*) pass headless with -nullrhi, including engine-parity checks of the UniSeed port against ProcSeed / HashCombine / FRandomStream.
Every .usf entry point compiles under the engine shader compiler (DXC was not runnable here).
GPU execution parity: the shared cores give the same results on the GPU as their CPU runs through UniHlslShim.h (integer cores bitwise, float cores statistically, D-105).
Render hooks: the scene view extension subscribes at the intended points on the project's engine version (D-006), and sprites appear with scene-depth occlusion.
Flythrough in the editor: `uu.Flythrough` console command on an empty level shows the backdrop, with no jitter and no pops.

Promotion handoff appearance: the reference renderer showed the sprite's glare far larger than the promoted body (OBSERVATIONS.md). In UE there is no promotion actor pool yet, so promoted stars stay sprites; check how the glare reads with real bloom.

Runtime cost: GPU time of the generate / project / sprite passes, the one-time game-thread hitch of the normalising integral when entering a galaxy (D-123), and teleport fill latency (about 37 frames, D-122).

The volume pass in the engine (Docs/VOLUMETRICS.md §8) is written but has never been compiled: UniVolume.usf (MarchCS, BackgroundCS, CompositeVS/PS), the sprite transmittance lookup, RenderVolume_RenderThread and the subsystem's per-frame volume scene. It must compile, show the galaxy glow and the dust lane matching the reference stills, and stay within budget (uu.Volume 0/1 to compare).

Star systems in the engine (D-142 to D-145): the activation append and readback ring in UniProject.usf / RenderBackdrop_RenderThread, the planet-record scatter into the reserved pool tail, the subsystem's clock and system manager. Planets must appear near uu.GotoSystem, move with uu.TimeScale, and activate/deactivate without flicker (REVIEW_TONIGHT §9).

M3 in the engine (D-146, D-147): UUniParallaxComponent placement (real space vs compressed, no jitter against the backdrop at any speed), AUniBodyActor placeholders spawned and destroyed on promotion, promoted planets' sprites culled, the light rig, and sprites hidden behind promoted bodies by the decoded depth test (REVIEW_TONIGHT §10).

Galaxy clusters and travel sensitivity in the engine (D-151 to D-154): the 208-byte task struct with sampling boxes and the cluster envelope bound on the GPU, uu.Cluster.* tuning, uu.Clusters / uu.GotoCluster, residency (~14k clusters) and game-thread cost, and the speed-driven sensitivity (REVIEW_TONIGHT §11).

Sprite style, instrumentation and volume cost in the engine (D-156, D-157): the 64-byte sprite with core + halo, uu.Sprite.* handles, uu.Perf / uu.PerfHud / uu.PerfHitchMs and the Insights scopes, the cluster step hint's GPU cost, the volume quality CVars (REVIEW_TONIGHT §12).

The web texture in the engine (D-164): the include of UniWebTexture.ush in every .usf, the Texture3D + wrap/trilinear sampler bound to the generation probe/place passes and the volume passes, the upload compute pass (UniWebTexUpload.usf), the bake/cache in Saved/UnifiedUniverse, uu.WebSource / uu.WebTexSize, and the GPU cost of Uni.Volume.Background with it (REVIEW_TONIGHT §13).

Contributors woken by distance at intergalactic speed in the engine (D-168): game-thread cost with uu.Enable flythrough from rest to ~100 Mpc/s with travel sensitivity (Measure, Wake, Register, Window in the hitch line), WakeTheta from the renderer's pixel angle, no missing stars or glow while moving (REVIEW_TONIGHT §13e).

Galaxy groups and dwarfs in the engine (D-174): groups resident from the node list, uu.GotoGroup [rich] landing at a group with its dwarfs and the web's bright galaxies around it, uu.Clusters listing clusters and groups from resident objects, uu.Group.Enable / uu.Group.Dwarfs, and no game-thread or GPU cost visible from groups (REVIEW_TONIGHT §13j).

The hybrid cluster split and map dwarfs in the engine (D-176, D-177): game-thread cost at intergalactic speed with uu.Enable flythrough and travel sensitivity (hitch lines: Submit, Levels, Wake; AwakeByAngle and WakeStep), clusters looking as before up close (uu.GotoCluster rich: bright members around the core, ellipticals in it), uu.GotoGroup and uu.Clusters finding groups (labels, no emitter), dwarfs clumped on nodes (REVIEW_TONIGHT §13k).

Galaxy disc modes in the engine (D-178): the 128-byte field parameters and 272-byte generation task on the GPU (automation struct sizes, placement unchanged in kind), rolled warps, lopsidedness and uneven arms visible on galaxies at a few degrees, the Milky Way band as before with a gentle outer warp (REVIEW_TONIGHT §14).

Galaxy textures in the engine (D-179): uu.Enable logs the three galaxy textures loaded; the generation and volume passes bind them (no NaN dummy while loaded: galaxies place stars and glow); galaxies at a few degrees show patchy discs, clumpy arms and wiggled lanes; uu.GalaxyTextures 0 + uu.Enable gives the D-178 look; game-thread cost unchanged and GPU cost of Uni.Volume.March with three more texture reads per galaxy sample (REVIEW_TONIGHT §15).

Galaxy palettes in the engine (D-182): galaxies at a few degrees in their own colours (gold bulges, teal / warm / violet discs, blue-violet arms, pink knots), the same colours carried into their stars as you fly in (no shift back to white as stars resolve), the galaxy sprite's colour matching its glow at the hand-off, uu.GalaxyPalettes 0 for an A/B; shader compile of the palette code (HLSL only rejects some forms the C++ build accepts) (REVIEW_TONIGHT §16).

Inclined galaxy sprites in the engine (D-183): galaxies a few to tens of pixels across read as ellipses at their discs' inclinations (edge-on needles, face-on discs) with no change in brightness; the ellipse lines up with the volume's glow at the hand-off (no rotation or squash jump); one- or two-pixel galaxies stay round; uu.SpriteEllipses 0 for an A/B; shader compile of the new sprite interpolants and the project pass's FixedDiscSeeds (REVIEW_TONIGHT §17).

Temporal slicing of the volume march in the engine (D-184): ProfileGPU shows Uni.Volume.March with ', 1/4 sliced' at about a quarter of its D-181 cost inside a galaxy, plus a cheap Uni.Volume.Reconstruct; no visible 2 x 2 pattern, smearing or lag in the glow while turning and flying (inside a galaxy, past galaxies at intergalactic speed); edges of promoted bodies against the glow stay clean; uu.VolumeTemporal 0 for an A/B; shader compile of the reconstruct pass (REVIEW_TONIGHT §18).

Star halos in the engine (D-185 amended, D-188): no square cut around bright stars up close or far away (the quad now reaches until the light falls below uu.Sprite.Floor, with a soft edge); halos more saturated than the core (uu.Sprite.HaloChroma 1 for an A/B); the engine's bloom and lens flares pick up bright stars (spikes withdrawn: Convolution Bloom with a spiked kernel if wanted; uu.Sprite.Saturation 0 hands all of a star's light to them); shader compile of the sprite pass (REVIEW_TONIGHT §19).

Sky light from the backdrop in the engine (D-186): a transient movable sky light appears after uu.Enable; promoted bodies are lit from the galaxy's band on their dark side and reflect it, brightest towards the galactic centre; the light follows travel without popping (1 s blends); no game-thread hitch (the cube is built on a worker); uu.SkyLight 0 removes it; the cube's orientation matches the sky (REVIEW_TONIGHT §20).

Warp streaks and arrival in the engine (D-187): at intergalactic speed stars and small galaxies streak back towards the vanishing point (none while turning in place, none at rest), with no change in overall brightness; objects in late cells stream in from ahead over ~8 frames instead of popping; uu.Warp 0 for an A/B; uu.Warp.StreakFrames, StreakMax, Arrival, ArrivalStretch for tuning; shader compile of the project and sprite passes (REVIEW_TONIGHT §22).

The web in the sky in the engine (D-189): uu.SkyWeb 0 physical (default), 1 near-web glow, 2 dimmed tail, 3 both; the background re-marches on a change; no seam or blockiness; uu.SkyWeb.Glow, Depth, Tail for tuning; the owner picks the default (REVIEW_TONIGHT §23).

Warp optics in the engine (D-190): at speed the sky crowds ahead (forward cone ~1.7x tighter at full warp), blue ahead and red behind, the view centre fixed; sprites, volume and background agree (no stars sliding off their glow); temporal reprojection clean while flying; uu.Warp.Aberration, Doppler, Beaming; shader compile of the volume, project and sprite passes (REVIEW_TONIGHT §24).

Brightest cluster galaxies and intracluster light in the engine (D-191): one giant early-type galaxy at the centre of each rich catalogue cluster, its brightest; a smooth diffuse glow over the cluster with no pop-in; the cluster's overall brightness unchanged; the cost inside a rich core (REVIEW_TONIGHT §25).

Warp motes in the engine (D-192): faint motes fixed in space stream past and streak at speed in a void, none at rest, no pops while accelerating; uu.Warp.Motes, MoteFrames, MoteMag; the second sprite draw (Uni.WarpMotes) compiles and costs little (REVIEW_TONIGHT §26).

Runtime API in the engine (D-193): the pick and query passes (UniQuery.usf) and the project pass's sprite sources compile; uu.Pick names the star under the screen centre (nothing on empty sky; a planet names its star and ordinal); uu.Query / uu.Nearest list resident objects nearest first; uu.Events counts resident / evicted galaxies at speed; the Blueprint calls and events are exposed; no cost on frames without a request (REVIEW_TONIGHT §27).

Volume ghosting at speed in the engine (D-194): flying past galaxies and through clusters at intergalactic speed while turning, no trails or dark holes behind moving glow (A/B uu.VolumeTemporal.Clamp 0, reference uu.VolumeTemporal 0); no shimmer at rest; uu.VolumeTemporal.MaxMotionPx / TightPx tuning; reconstruct pass compiles (REVIEW_TONIGHT §28).

Volume march cost inside a galaxy (D-195): Uni.Volume time against the earlier 20-31 ms, at rest and moving through dense areas; the look against uu.VolumeStepRatio 0.08 / uu.VolumeHintScale 1 / uu.VolumeStartPc 1 (no banding toward the centre, no thinner near dust) (REVIEW_TONIGHT §29).

Volume cost, sprite handoff and warp default in the engine (D-196): fps and ProfileGPU's per-pass volume scopes at the worst-case spot; uu.perf march size and per-pixel background frames; the glow at uu.VolumeMaxMarchPixels 262144 against 0; no sprite fading before its glow (approach, cluster core); project pass compiles with InHandoffs (REVIEW_TONIGHT §30).

Fewer stars and cluster galaxies in the engine (D-197): uu.perf counts and fps against D-196 at the same spots; galaxies' and clusters' glow unchanged in brightness; uu.Star.Keep 1 / uu.Cluster.MemberKeep 1 (and uu.Enable) restore the full draw (REVIEW_TONIGHT §31).

D-198 in the engine: fps and ProfileGPU volume scopes in a dense part of the Milky Way and at 1-10 Mpc/s; the darker dust's look (uu.Galaxy.DustScale / DustLanes); no banding at uu.VolumeHintScale 3; the glow at speed with uu.VolumeTravelPixelScale 0.35 (REVIEW_TONIGHT §32).

D-199 in the engine: fps with uu.VolumeStepRatio 0.32 (no banding), the background while travelling fast (textured web ratio 0.4), and uu.Warp 1 at 0.4-10 Mpc/s: galaxies streak, do not vanish (REVIEW_TONIGHT §33).

D-200 volume auto budget in the engine: compiles (RHIGetGPUFrameCycles, DynamicRHI.h); at the worst spots uu.perf's level settles where the GPU fits 60 fps and holds; no visible pumping (REVIEW_TONIGHT §34).
D-202: fps at 1-30 Mpc/s with uu.VolumeWebTravelHint 2 against 1 (and 3); the web's filaments keep their brightness and shape while accelerating (REVIEW_TONIGHT §36).

D-203 cell glow in the engine: shaders compile (UniVolume.ush: firstbitlow, countbits); fps and stat unit at 1-30 Mpc/s and through a galaxy against uu.CellGlow 0 / uu.StreamBuildBudget 0 / uu.WindowStretch 3; loading cells read as glow condensing into points, no holes, no glow left behind (REVIEW_TONIGHT §37).

D-204 in the engine: UniProject.usf compiles (FUniCellRel, Uni_ProjectObjectC); ProfileGPU's project pass in a dense galaxy core before and after; no sprite jitter across cell boundaries or against promoted actors (REVIEW_TONIGHT §38).

D-205 in the engine: nearby clusters visible at 1-30 Mpc/s with uu.TravelExposure; mid-speed travel through a galaxy core no longer lags (A/B uu.CellGlow, uu.StreamBuildBudget, uu.WindowStretch with stat unit and uu.perf) (REVIEW_TONIGHT §39).
D-206: UniVolume.ush / UniFields.ush compile with the shared web texel; ProfileGPU Uni.Volume.March+Background at speed before and after (REVIEW_TONIGHT §40).
D-207: UniGen.usf AllocCS and the place pass's InAlloc compile; stars arrive sooner at speed (uu.GenOneTrip A/B); pool use flat, no generation timeouts (REVIEW_TONIGHT §41).
D-208: the glow's slicing at 4 x 4 / 3 x 3 when near still: shaders compile, Uni.Volume.March 1/16 sliced at rest in a core, no pattern or shimmer when starting and stopping (REVIEW_TONIGHT §42).

D-209: at rest the background stays in its map (uu.Perf: per pixel in ~0 frames, re-marches only when moving); the slicing line counts 1/16 frames at rest; fps at the owner's costly view with uu.VolumeMaxMarchPixels 262144 (REVIEW_TONIGHT §43).

D-210: UniFields.ush / UniVolume.ush compile (FUniGalaxyConst, the K forms, Uni_CarrierStepLimit); ProfileGPU Uni.Volume.March in the core before/after; no swirls or rings toward the centre (REVIEW_TONIGHT §44).

D-212 galaxy map in the engine: shaders compile (UniGalMap, MapBakeCS, MapDownCS); the GPU bake over frames on entering a galaxy (Uni.GalaxyMap.Bake, at 1024 and 2048); Uni.Volume.March with uu.GalaxyMap 0 / 1 in the core and at the solar circle; the look matches the field (REVIEW_TONIGHT §46).
D-213 cleanup: the engine builds and shaders compile after the removals (clipmap, window stretch, travel sensitivity, uu.VolumeGalaxyConst); look and fps unchanged (REVIEW_TONIGHT §47).

D-214 generation load: UniGen.usf's PROBE / ALLOC / EVAL / SCAN / WRITE compile and give the CPU's records (UniGpuParityTest), galaxy stars placed from the slotted galaxy-map array (stars appear in every galaxy entered), uu.GenFrameCandidates caps a frame's work, in-view cells first; the dense-region stutter at speed gone at uu.Star.Keep 0.35 (REVIEW_TONIGHT §48).

D-215: the volume reconstruct reprojects the history across a march resize (HistSize): uu.Perf shows no 'march size changed' unsliced frames while the auto budget changes level, no 100 ms volume frames while streaming, no smear after a level change (REVIEW_TONIGHT §49).

D-216: Play begins in the flythrough universe in free flight (uu.AutoStart, uu.AutoFly); the sky light swaps its cube every 2 s without per-frame blend recaptures: uu.Perf's light-rig peak small, no sky-light hitch (REVIEW_TONIGHT §50).

D-218: the bulge's warp_large read only inside 8 effective radii (shader-only; Uni_GalaxyTexTerms): galaxies look unchanged (the field moves 0.07% per point offline); a slight gain in uu.Perf's volume time inside a galaxy's inner disc (REVIEW_TONIGHT §52).

D-220: galaxy discs warped at a structural level (warp_fine mip >= 2) with the fine band as a bounded multiplier (shader only; UniFields.ush): the rings flying top-down toward a galaxy's centre and the arcs inside one mostly gone; the look close to before (slightly grainier arms); stars in textured galaxies reroll (REVIEW_TONIGHT section 54).
